assets.name: home
assets.label: 首页
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production mobile navigation FUNCTION ICON, single square 1024x1024 render, genuinely transparent RGBA background.
Input image 1: exact Xiaohe mascot identity reference, not an edit target. Create an independently composed miniature icon faithfully matching this same mascot.
Scene/backdrop: absolutely transparent empty space; isolated character and one functional prop, no background or environment.
Subject: Xiaohe's broad rounded ivory ceramic head, deep forest-green face screen, exactly TWO fresh green leaf sprouts growing from its crown, luminous friendly mint eyes and a gentle small smile, green circular ear discs, and two tiny ivory hands. Same recognisable broad head and face proportions as the reference.
Style/medium: premium simplified soft 3D miniature mascot icon, matte ivory ceramic and forest-green surfaces, clean rounded forms, soft studio light. Minimal fine details, crisp simple silhouette immediately readable at 40px.
Composition/framing: head-and-hands bust ONLY, no torso, legs or feet. Centered, front three-quarter view very close to frontal, total icon fills approximately 88% of the square with breathing room at every edge. The head is above ONE oversized functional prop in the lower front, prop approximately 35% of the design; tiny hands touch the prop. Keep the head and face large and fully readable.
Palette: warm ivory and forest green mascot, pale mint functional prop with subtle soft sky accents.
Text: none.
Constraints: preserve the exact Xiaohe identity; exactly two leaf sprouts; single character; only the specified prop. Genuine transparent alpha around the whole icon.
Avoid: badge, background, floor, cast shadow, plaque, border, text, letters, numbers, writing, watermark, sparkle, scenery, extra objects, extra limbs, full body, small distant mascot, photographic realism, strong glossy reflections.
Functional prop for this HOME icon: one softly rounded pale mint little HOUSE with a clean peaked roof and one dark green door. Xiaohe peeks over the house with its two tiny hands resting on the roof edges. The house is a large simple solid form, instantly recognisable at small size, no windows or decorations.

assets.name: profile
assets.label: 个人中心与小禾
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production-ready 3D miniature mascot FUNCTION ICON for the Chinese AgriScan mobile app.
Image 1 is the sole character identity reference, not a scene or composition target. Preserve this exact Xiaohe mascot identity: very broad softly rounded ivory ceramic head, deep forest-green face screen, TWO fresh green leaf sprouts from the top, luminous friendly green eyes and a small kind smile, ivory little hands, green circular ear discs. Make a head-and-hands bust icon only. No legs, no visible torso, no full-body figure.
Output: square 1024 x 1024, genuinely transparent alpha background. Isolated character, not a badge or app tile. Center the complete silhouette, filling approximately 88 percent of the square with a clean 6 percent breathing margin. Large simple readable shapes recognizable at 40px. Matte ceramic finish and soft studio illumination on the object only. Ivory white and deep forest green, with pale mint and soft sky blue functional accents. Crisp polished edges, restrained detail. Keep the same head shape, eye design, leaf proportions, and materials as the reference.
Strict exclusions: no background color or environment, no checkerboard baked into image, no floor, no cast shadow, no plate, no plaque, no border, no badge, no text, no letters, no numerals, no watermark, no sparkles, no decorative floating objects. Do not retain the magnifying glass or loose leaf from the reference.
Function: PROFILE / personal account. Front-facing recognizable Xiaohe face looking directly at viewer. ONE small ivory hand is raised beside the cheek in a simple friendly wave; the other hand is not visible. Head, two leaf sprouts, green ear discs and this one waving hand only. No functional prop or any other object. Maximize the face size while keeping both leaf sprouts and the hand fully in frame.
